reason: I'd take the free listing, sure, but I already have SQR and a card terminal, and my regulars just pay at the counter. Another system with its own per-transaction fee on top doesn't obviously bring me 59 lari of extra business a month, and the three free months just push that question back.
objection: I'd be paying twice: 59 a month plus the payment partner's fee on every bill, for guests I mostly already know by name. I'm not sure my regulars would bother scanning a QR code instead of handing me a card.
would_change_my_mind: Proof from a café my size in Tbilisi that the loyalty offers actually brought regulars back more often, enough to cover the fee in the first month, and a transaction fee no higher than what my bank terminal charges.
